1._note: Environment splats only (post B0 separation). If separation is not done, use the full PLY and accept subject leakage labeled PREVIZ.

2._note: Export once from camera_path_4cezar_loop.npy (1200 samples) via the provided convert script; then reuse.

3._note: Render environment-only frames along the loop. No Cezar, no color work. Output is the depth/mask/camera reference for Stage C conditioning.

4._note: Depth sequence for IC-LoRA depth conditioning in Workflow C.

5._note: Save depth + mask + camera-move sequences for reuse across all event takes.

trajectory_note: camera_path_4cezar_loop.npy has 1200 samples; resample to each shot's frame count when conditioning takes. A converter (npy -> trajectory json with per-frame position + look-at the event anchor) ships as convert_trajectory.py in this package.
